whys.why: Why did the 'about 15 s' check read 5.2 s?
whys.because: The grader measured one generated clip, not a full 15 s ad. In the new build it had only the separate clips: 5 s and 6 s scenes plus a music file.
whys.evidence: s4.new.happy.H40a/grade.json: 'about 15 s' fail, got 5.2 s. Files are 2 mp4 (480x858) and 1 wav. calls.jsonl line 2: plan_video_production plans 4 clips (2 s card, 5 s scene, 6 s scene, 2 s card), seconds:15, join [1,2,3,4].

whys.why: Why did the grader have only the clips and not the joined film?
whys.because: In the new build, join_production_clips does make the full-length film. But the harness cannot download it: the download fails with a 404, so the film never reaches the graded files.
whys.evidence: s4.new.happy.H44b/calls.jsonl line 9: join returns seconds 8.1 and checked 'One file, 8 s, 9:16 → yes', but files = 'download failed: download 404 http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/…mp4'. grade.json then measures 3 s, the countdown clip alone. s4.new.dumper.H42a line 13: join gives 9.2 s and the same 404. grade.json: 'about 9 s' got 3 s.

whys.because: The new local build serves joined films from its own local file server (127.0.0.1:8000/films/…). The harness fetches outputs from that URL, and that server does not serve the file to the harness (404). Generated clips, in contrast, come from videos.magichour.ai and download without problems.
whys.evidence: In H44b and H42a, every wait_for_video_project file under videos.magichour.ai is saved (assets/01-…mp4). Only the 127.0.0.1:8000 join URLs fail. The assistant gave the user that local link as the deliverable (H42a line 17).

whys.why: Why do old-build chats also fail (10 of 33)?
whys.because: The old hosted build has no tool to join clips. On the free plan, one video_from_image or video_from_text call is limited to 5 s, so the assistant delivers one 5 s clip.
whys.evidence: s4.old.stupid.H41a/calls.jsonl: one create_video_from_image call with end_seconds 5 (ltx-2.5, 480p). Reply: 'The free plan limits this type of video to 5 seconds.' grade.json: 'about 10 s' got 5 s. s4.old.stupid.H44c grade.json: 'about 10 s' got 5 s.

whys.why: Why is this the end of the chain?
whys.because: New build (23/33): the harness cannot fetch the server's local film URL. This is a defect of the test harness, not of the assistant or the model; the join tool reports the right length. Old build (10/33): the 5 s free-plan limit per clip, with no way to join clips, is a fixed limit of the hosted product.
whys.evidence: In H44b and H42a, the join results confirm the right lengths (8.1 s, 9.2 s), while the harness logs '404'. In H41a, the assistant states the free-plan 5 s limit.

result.axiom: New build (23/33 failures): the harness cannot download the joined film from the server's local URL (http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/…, 404). The grader then measures the longest single clip (5.2 s) and not the 15 s film that join_production_clips reports. This is a harness artifact. Old build (10/33): the free plan limits each clip to 5 s, and the build has no join tool. This is an inherent limit of that build.
result.fix: Make the harness collect join outputs. Option 1: serve the films directory of the local build on an address the harness can reach. Option 2: have join_production_clips copy the file into the chat's assets folder. Then grade the joined mp4, not the separate clips. Make the harness flag a failed deliverable download as a harness error, not a duration failure. For the old build: none, inherent (5 s free-plan limit per clip, no join tool).
